seed: A video window says its name, picture size, length and whether it is saved in its title bar, at Next defaults with no flag touched, the way video.html draws it (launch-teaser · 1920 x 1080 · 0:15 · saved). The sample recording opens and the line reads its name, size, length and saved; a Command K cut turns the last word to edited; Command S saves the edit as a project and the line takes the project's name and says saved again. A still picture opened after it gets no line: its title bar stays as it was.

steps.note: the sample recording at Next defaults, untouched: the title bar says its name, size and length, and saved
one Command K cut: the last word of the line turns to edited
Command S saved the edit as a project: the line takes the project's name and says saved
a still picture has no length: its title bar stays as it was, with no line
